headline: Redwood Chemicals opens new production line in Pune
body: Redwood Chemicals commissioned a new line at its Pune site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Analysts trim outlook for Redwood Chemicals on softer demand
body: Two analysts lowered their outlook for Redwood Chemicals, citing softer demand and rising input costs. No change to guidance has been announced.

headline: Labor union calls strike at Redwood Chemicals Pune facility
body: Workers at the Pune facility of Redwood Chemicals voted to strike over pay and safety conditions. Production at the site may be disrupted.

headline: Redwood Chemicals appoints new regional sales director
body: Redwood Chemicals announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.
